The usual cause is a merge lease held by another PR. The alert step in `review_autofix.yml` had no case for that reason, so it fell to the catch-all and paged **CRITICAL "PR review blocked — autofix exhausted (5 iterations)"** on every judge re-fire.

On 2026-11-21/22 that sent false pages for PRs #9502 and #9510. Their real autofix iteration counts were 4 and 2, their checks were green and the judge had approved. The merge was waiting on the lease held by #9402 / #9359 (`MERGE_LEASE pr=9502 ... outcome=wait reason=held holder=9402`, runs 44981189867, 44990076249, 44984735702).

## Changes

- **`.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`**
  - New `base_freshness_unknown)` alert case at level **WARNING** (a stuck lease is real, so it is not DEBUG). It names the lease holder when known.
  - On a repeat for the same head it logs `RB_JUDGE_FRESHNESS_ALERT ... repeat=true level=SUPPRESSED` and sends nothing.
  - The judge-crash alert still wins when both apply.
- **`scripts/review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh`**
  - Accurate PR comment text for this reason, instead of "maximum number of autofix iterations".
  - The #9249 per-head dedupe now picks one marker per run. The new marker is `<!-- rb-judge-base-freshness:v1 head=<sha> -->`, keyed on head only.
  - Same fail-open behaviour as before: a failed comment read posts anyway.
